findings.title: UUID subclasses can substitute a different canonical identifier
findings.description: canonical_id calls the overridable UUID.__str__ dispatch and validates only the returned text. A UUID subclass containing one identifier can return a different, canonical-looking RFC 4122 UUID and canonical_id accepts and returns that different identity. This violates the function contract to return the supplied UUID value in canonical wire form. The added regression closes the non-UUID-text case but does not cover canonical-looking identity substitution.
findings.required_change: Derive the wire form from trusted UUID value state without invoking an overridden __str__, and add a regression asserting that a UUID subclass cannot substitute a different canonical UUID. Rerun all KL-003 checks and refresh the result and evidence before rereview.
